subtopic: Assessing Advisory Services and Discretionary Authority
source_evidence: Will the adviser have the discretionary authority to make trades in your account, or will your pre-authorization be required for every trade?
question: Misconception: Paying a subscription-based advisory fee automatically gives the adviser discretionary authority to trade in my account.
answer: A subscription-based fee does not by itself establish whether the adviser can make trades without your approval. Check the advisory agreement to learn whether the adviser has discretionary authority or whether your pre-authorization is required for each trade.
